# BuzzerBidder

> ShopGoodwill sniper that compares auctions to eBay comps and places last-second bids.
> Pay 2% only when you win (Standard), or $10/month Pro with 0% commission.
> Independent tool — not affiliated with ShopGoodwill or Goodwill Industries.

## Product facts

- Hosted last-second bidding with durable snipe queue
- eBay sold comps (fees + shipping estimates) when queueing auctions
- ShopGoodwill Favorites sync
- Credentials encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM)
- Standard: 2% hammer on confirmed wins; Pro: $10/mo, 0% success fee
- Snipes can still miss (site/network/proxy competition)
